The 6-Column Championship Gauntlet! 1,400,000,000 watching live, $10,000,000 on the brass table, all 6 Jewel Wedges, chained vaults, hidden Power Plays, and all 7 formats against undefeated Grandmaster Viktor Volkov!

optionalDare.description: Claim 3 Crown Wedges on the 6-Column Championship Gauntlet against Viktor Volkov.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Brass desk line is ringing off the hook. Operator says forty regulars in Brooklyn pooled quarters to call London.

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Kid, tell me you can hear the jukebox! Whole tavern watched the British preview and we already spotted Lord Finch's tell.

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: He acts like television was invented last Tuesday. Hit him with Pop Culture or Tech on the Screw buzzer and watch his waistcoat sweat.

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Also FedExed my lucky tavern coaster to your podium tray. First Double Down slip won't cost you a dime.

choices.label: Save my barstool, Frankie — I'm playing for Oakridge.
choices.playerSpokenText: Tell the regulars I'm putting that coaster dead center on the London podium. Next round of ginger ale is on me.
choices.rivalReplyText: Hear that, everybody? The kid still remembers the folding chairs! Go rattle some royal porcelain tonight.

choices.label: Should I quiz Alistair on 1990s sitcom theme songs?
choices.playerSpokenText: If I throw a 1994 sitcom clue at a Classics Fellow on BBC prime time, do I owe the Crown an apology?
choices.rivalReplyText: Ha! Only if he drops his monocle into his teacup. Keep him off History and hit him where he's blind.

choices.label: Keep the quarters, Frankie — I'll beat him on his own turf.
choices.playerSpokenText: Appreciate the coaster, Frankie, though I'm not dodging his Classics either. I'm taking the whole Rotunda board.
choices.rivalReplyText: Whoa, listen to that swagger! Just don't get proud and leave your chin open when the big wagers drop.

closingBeats.speaker: narrator
closingBeats.text: The cork coaster smells faintly of lime twist and home. Suddenly the grand marble Rotunda feels a little less cold.

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: Stand up straight when you hold the receiver, please. I argued Latin footnotes with Alistair Finch at an Oxford symposium in 1998.

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: In the Oxford Pick & Ban Draft, Alistair always bans Pop Culture first, then freezes your favorite column on Turn 2 to herd you into Classics.

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: Ban Architecture or Mythology before he can lock the board, and take my red fountain pen — it still crosses out weak decoys on sight.

choices.label: Best lecture I've ever had, Professor Park.
choices.playerSpokenText: I took notes on every word, Denise. I'll keep my posture straight and my dates cleaner than an Oxford thesis.
choices.rivalReplyText: Magnificent. Now go give Alistair the failing mark I've owed him for twenty-five years.

choices.label: Did you grade Alistair in red ink in 1998 too?
choices.playerSpokenText: Wait — did you actually red-pen a Lord of Oxford over a Roman treaty date?
choices.rivalReplyText: He confused the Peace of Nicias with a dinner reservation. He deserved every crimson margin note.

choices.label: Let him pick Classics — I want his strongest column.
choices.playerSpokenText: Thanks for the pen, Denise, but if Alistair leaves History on the board I'm sweeping it right out from under him.
choices.rivalReplyText: Audacious — slightly reckless, yet undeniably thrilling. Don't prove me wrong in front of sixty-eight million people.

closingBeats.speaker: producer_sam
closingBeats.text: Two minutes to air! Tuck Denise's fountain pen onto your podium tray and let's go shake London.

scenes.title: Trauma-Shift Scouting Report
scenes.locationSubhead: Shibuya VIP Green Room · Rain on the Glass

beats.speaker: priya_nair
beats.speakerRole: Boston ER Ally on the Line
beats.text: Between night-shift charts in Boston and I've been watching Kenji Takahashi's Shibuya tape. His pulse never breaks sixty-five.

beats.speaker: priya_nair
beats.speakerRole: Boston ER Ally on the Line
beats.text: Here's the diagnosis: Kenji relies on Ice & Fire tempo and 2x Gold Fever runs. Don't rush his speed — crack a Flame tile early to thaw his column locks.

beats.speaker: priya_nair
beats.speakerRole: Boston ER Ally on the Line
beats.text: And if Culinary or Fine Arts lights up, slam SCREW RIVAL right on his podium. I couriered my Adrenaline vial charm to your locker.

choices.label: You're saving my tour between ER shifts, Priya.
choices.playerSpokenText: You're literally diagnosing a Tokyo shogi prodigy on four hours of sleep. I owe you dinner when this circus lands.
choices.rivalReplyText: Make it strong espresso and a calm heartbeat under those jumbotrons. Beat him cleanly.

choices.label: Prescription received: one Culinary Screw, taken hot.
choices.playerSpokenText: So my medical orders are to force a shogi genius to identify French pastry sauces on live television?
choices.rivalReplyText: Clinically proven to spike his heart rate by twenty beats per minute. Watch his eyes widen when you press the dome.

choices.label: I'll beat Kenji at his own tempo too.
choices.playerSpokenText: Good intel, Priya — and once I shatter his ice columns, I'm matching his buzzer speed frame for frame.
choices.rivalReplyText: Careful — adrenaline cuts both ways. Keep your fingers steady when the countdown drops below five.

closingBeats.speaker: narrator
closingBeats.text: Outside the glass wall, thirty thousand Tokyo fans open glowing umbrellas. Your heart rate settles to a crisp, steady hum.

beats.speaker: alistair_finch
beats.text: Good evening from a dreadfully rainy quad. Do forgive the intrusion, yet Nadia Al-Mansoor dismantled me in Cairo two seasons ago and I bear an academic grudge.

beats.speaker: alistair_finch
beats.text: She memorizes your entire Career Stats Radar before shaking hands. Expect her to force your single weakest category while guarding Geography and World Affairs.

beats.speaker: alistair_finch
beats.text: She barely follows box-office cinema or stadium sports. Use my Pocketwatch on your podium for extra clock breath, then strike her flanks.

choices.label: Never thought an Oxford Lord would be in my corner.
choices.playerSpokenText: Your pocketwatch and your scouting notes mean more than you know, Alistair. I'll avenge your Cairo evening.
choices.rivalReplyText: Splendid manners as ever. Do remember to breathe when the desert wind rattles the brass podiums.

choices.label: Wait — are you recommending Pop Culture strategy?
choices.playerSpokenText: Hold the line, Alistair. Did a Classics Fellow just advise me to attack with movies and sports?
choices.rivalReplyText: Desperate civilizations deploy desperate weapons. Pray never repeat that quote to the faculty senate.

choices.label: Let Nadia target my weak spot — I fixed it.
choices.playerSpokenText: Appreciate the watch, Alistair, though I want Nadia testing my old blind spot. Watching her plan fail will break the match open.
choices.rivalReplyText: Good heavens, what nerve. If you pull that off under the Pyramids, I'll buy a television set myself.

closingBeats.speaker: producer_sam
closingBeats.text: Sixty broadcast trucks just synced satellite uplinks. Giza is waiting — show them what you learned.

beats.speaker: kenji_takahashi
beats.text: Yo! Calling from a rainy booth outside the Shibuya dome. I ran twelve simulations of Giza's Power-Play Minefield and 6-column Gauntlet for you.

beats.speaker: kenji_takahashi
beats.text: Here's the line nobody sees: players fear hidden Power-Play mines and play timid. Trigger one early with a cool head and you snowball the entire middle board.

beats.speaker: kenji_takahashi
beats.text: Slot my Cyber Link onto your podium before Nadia steps up. Lock answers inside six seconds and ride the speed surge straight to Finals Week.

choices.label: You ran twelve board sims for a rival? Pure class, Kenji.
choices.playerSpokenText: After everything we threw at each other in Shibuya, you're still handing me endgame theory at 2 AM. True grandmaster spirit.
choices.rivalReplyText: Only the strongest player deserves to face Viktor Volkov. Go prove Shibuya forged steel.

choices.label: So your advice is to step on the mines on purpose?
choices.playerSpokenText: Let me get this straight: step directly onto live wager bombs before 700 million people?
choices.rivalReplyText: Haha, yes! Controlled chaos beats cautious math every time. Just make sure you actually know the clue.

choices.label: Watch me speedrun Giza and Volkov back to back.
choices.playerSpokenText: Cyber Link locked in. I'm taking Nadia's Semifinal, then I'm rewriting Viktor's world record live.
choices.rivalReplyText: That's the frame-perfect confidence I wanted to hear! Clip-worthy highlights only tonight.

closingBeats.speaker: narrator
closingBeats.text: Across the desert skyline, floodlights strike the Great Pyramid in gold. You aren't climbing alone anymore.

scenes.title: The Polyglot's Secret Crack in the Armor
scenes.locationSubhead: Global VIP Suite · Eve of the 1.4B Finale

beats.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
beats.text: Are the cameras finally off in your suite? Good. I lost to Viktor Volkov by one hundred points three years ago, and I have replayed that final board every month since.

beats.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
beats.text: Viktor is a monument in History, Science, Geography, and Logic. People think he is unbeatable because they try to out-monument him.

beats.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
beats.text: His single human flaw is ordinary joy — Food, Culinary craft, and Pop Culture. Save your red SCREW RIVAL dome for those columns, and carry my Astrolabe onto the stage.

choices.label: I'm carrying every ounce of Giza onto that podium, Nadia.
choices.playerSpokenText: You pushed me harder than anyone alive, and now you're handing me the key to the crown. I won't waste it.
choices.rivalReplyText: I knew you belonged in that spotlight the moment you stepped beneath the stars. Make the room feel warm, not cold.

choices.label: So Grandmaster Volkov can't name a taco seasoning?
choices.playerSpokenText: Three-time World Champion, master of empires, felled by street food and chart-topping pop songs?
choices.rivalReplyText: Precision without curiosity is a fragile fortress. Smile when you press that red dome.

choices.label: I'll crack his fortress from the inside out.
choices.playerSpokenText: I'll trap him on Pop and Culinary, then take his History Crown Wedge right in front of 1.4 billion witnesses.
choices.rivalReplyText: Bold enough to rattle even Viktor's composure. I will be standing in the front row when the brass crown changes hands.

closingBeats.speaker: narrator
closingBeats.text: Nadia's brass Astrolabe catches the dressing-room vanity bulbs. Outside, the symphony warms up the opening brass chord.

scenes.title: Ten Minutes to Air: The All-Allies Line
scenes.locationSubhead: Global VIP Suite · Conference Line Patched Worldwide

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Ten minutes to simulcast! Stop pacing — our switchboard just crashed because six former rivals bridged an international conference line to your room.

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Kid, we got Brooklyn, Evanston, Boston, Oxford, Tokyo, and Cairo all crammed onto one speaker! Denise is literally shushing a British Lord!

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: Only because Alistair interrupted Priya's timing chart! Listen carefully: Viktor freezes your highest-accuracy column on Turn 3, every single final.

beats.speaker: kenji_takahashi
beats.text: So open wide on Turns 1 and 2, unlock the chained 400 vaults first, and hold your Screw buzzer until he's forced onto Pop or Culinary!

beats.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
beats.text: Viktor thinks genius is solitary. Walk out there remembering every room that built you — from forty-two folding chairs to tonight.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Well I'll be damned. Twenty years hosting live television and I've never seen six defeated champions build a war room for the kid who beat them.

choices.label: Every single one of you is walking onstage with me.
choices.playerSpokenText: I wouldn't have made it past Oakridge without you people. Keep the line open — we're bringing that crown home together.
choices.rivalReplyText: Now THAT is a championship speech! Go take the roof off the arena, kid!
choices.hostReplyText: Orchestra's hitting the downbeat! Let's make 1.4 billion jaws drop!

choices.label: Six rivals, one phone bill — hope Apex is paying!
choices.playerSpokenText: If Viktor sees six former bosses feeding me endgame theory over a brass landline, he might demand a recount before Turn 1.
choices.rivalReplyText: Ha! Let the network cover the long-distance charges — you just cover the scoreboard!
choices.hostReplyText: Put it on Apex's tab! Come on, champion, the spotlight's calling your name!

choices.label: Plan locked. Watch me dismantle perfection in 14 turns.
choices.playerSpokenText: Open wide, shatter the vaults, Screw his Pop flank, sweep the Gauntlet. Tell the engraver to warm up the chisel.
choices.rivalReplyText: Chills! Pure frame-perfect ice in those veins! Finish the job!
choices.hostReplyText: History doesn't knock politely — kick the velvet curtains wide open!

closingBeats.speaker: narrator
closingBeats.text: You set the brass handset down. Your three Podium Lucky Charms gleam in the tray. Beyond the crimson curtain, 1.4 billion people fall silent.

scenes.title: Across the Atlantic: Thames Fog Debut

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Fresh off a red-eye flight and straight into marble colonnades! Thirty-four million European viewers and live London odds are glued to your podium.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Welcome to London's signature twist: Fog of War Spotlight! Only lit center tiles show their faces — solve one to clear neighboring mist and reveal hidden Wedges.

beats.speaker: alistair_finch
beats.text: Do try not to spill American enthusiasm all over the Rotunda floor. Show us whether an open-call prodigy can navigate a little London mist.

choices.label: Honored to share the Rotunda floor, Lord Finch.
choices.playerSpokenText: I've read your Classics commentary, Alistair. Clearing this fog just to earn a match against you is privilege enough.
choices.rivalReplyText: Unexpectedly civilized! Perhaps television hasn't ruined the colonies entirely.

choices.label: Relax — the fog already smells like nervous bookmakers.
choices.playerSpokenText: I brought a lantern and a healthy disrespect for 40-to-1 British odds. Mind if I warm up your marble?
choices.rivalReplyText: Cheeky, brisk, and faintly scandalous. The tabloids are going to adore you.

choices.label: Watch closely from the balcony — you're next.
choices.playerSpokenText: Enjoy the dry applause while it lasts, Alistair. I didn't cross an ocean to play politely.
choices.rivalReplyText: My word. Keep a sharp eye on your weak columns — arrogance draws a hefty tariff in London.

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Cue the brass symphony! Part the Thames fog and let London hear your buzzer!

scenes.title: 1 AM in Soho: The Cellar Comeback
scenes.locationSubhead: The Crown & Buzzer Cellar · Soho, London

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Take a breath — one rough board never ended a champion's tour. Soho's late-night cellar wildcard feeds straight back into the Rotunda quarterfinals.

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Look who stumbled down the pub stairs! Grab a stool, kid — I cashed in my frequent-flyer miles to hustle the British wildcard circuit.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Nothing beats a midnight comeback! Shatter the chained padlocks against Frankie and claw straight back under the Rotunda dome.

choices.label: Just like Tuesday night in Oakridge, Frankie.
choices.playerSpokenText: You have no idea how good it feels to see a familiar face in a basement full of buzzers. Let's give Soho a show.
choices.rivalReplyText: That's the spirit! Loser buys the fish and chips, winner takes the Rotunda ticket!

choices.label: Did you smuggle your coffee urn through UK customs?
choices.playerSpokenText: Tell me British customs didn't confiscate the Oakridge coffee urn at Heathrow.
choices.rivalReplyText: They tried! Told 'em it was an antique cultural artifact. Now quit stalling and hit the board!

choices.label: I'm not staying in the cellar long, Frankie.
choices.playerSpokenText: Good seeing you, Frankie, but this basement is just a pit stop. I'm taking that wildcard in straight turns.
choices.rivalReplyText: Ooh, London lights already got you talking tough! Let's see if your buzzer backs it up.

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Padlocks on, rain pounding the sidewalk above — let's run the Soho wildcard!

scenes.title: The Wax-Sealed Folio of Oxford
scenes.locationSubhead: Bodleian Candlelight Cloister · Secret Velvet Salon

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: No TV cameras. No studio audience. Only twelve patrons behind silk curtains and a board crossed by twin crimson ribbons.

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: Surprised to see your AP History teacher wearing a crimson wax crest? Before I graded high-school essays, I defended this very table.

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: Behold Velvet Diagonal Crossroads: every tile along the two golden-crimson X diagonals pays double, meeting at the Crown. No lifelines if you want our Seal.

choices.label: No wonder your standards were sky-high, Denise.
choices.playerSpokenText: Thirty-four years teaching by day and holding court in Oxford by night. It's an honor to sit across your X-board.
choices.rivalReplyText: Eloquent and observant. Let us see if your recall holds when the applause track is gone.

choices.label: So this is where teachers go on summer break?
choices.playerSpokenText: I always figured teachers graded papers in July — turns out you run secret high-stakes salons in medieval cloisters.
choices.rivalReplyText: A sharp tongue earns extra credit only if you own the center diagonal. Proceed.

choices.label: Keep the lifelines locked — I'm taking the Velvet Wax Seal.
choices.playerSpokenText: Zero lifelines, double diagonals, candlelit pressure — hand me the buzzer and clear the crimson path.
choices.rivalReplyText: Hubris is a tragic Greek specialty. We shall test whether you survive the third act.

closingBeats.speaker: narrator
closingBeats.text: A single silver handbell chimes once. The crimson Velvet Crossroads ignites across the mahogany table.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Fifty-six million tuned in for London's sharpest mind-game: The Oxford Pick & Ban Draft! Before Turn 1, you and Alistair slash categories straight off the board!

beats.speaker: alistair_finch
beats.text: A gentleman never bullies an opponent — he merely bans their comfort zone before the clock starts. Do choose your columns with scholarly care.

choices.label: Pure chess before the first clue. I love this rule.
choices.playerSpokenText: Turning category selection into an opening gambit? Now I understand why London treats this stage like Wimbledon.
choices.rivalReplyText: Precisely! Finally an opponent who appreciates a civil war fought over footnotes.

choices.label: Banning Pop Culture again, Alistair?
choices.playerSpokenText: Let me guess: you're banning Film & Music because you still think the Beatles are a noisy fad.
choices.rivalReplyText: A passing breeze in Liverpool, nothing more. Mind your own glass house on the draft.

choices.label: Ban whatever you want — you can't ban all twelve domains.
choices.playerSpokenText: Cut my strongest subject if it calms your nerves. I'll still trap you on the five columns left standing.
choices.rivalReplyText: How terribly brisk. Let us see whether bravado answers an 800-point Classics vault.

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Draft pens down! Five hand-picked columns, one ruthless Rotunda showdown — play ball!

scenes.title: Grudge Ambush: Bounty on the Marble Floor
scenes.locationSubhead: Rotunda Backstage Press Pit · Live Feed

beats.speaker: trevor_blake
beats.text: Cameras rolling? Perfect! Remember how you embarrassed me back on domestic TV? Apex Network just handed me a blank Double-Bounty check to return the favor.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Whoa — backstage ambush turned live broadcast! Trevor pulled your Career Stats sheet and locked a Spiral Labyrinth around your toughest topic!

choices.label: You flew across an ocean for a rematch? Respect, Trevor.
choices.playerSpokenText: Honestly, I admire the hustle. If you want a fair spotlight rematch in London, step behind the podium.
choices.rivalReplyText: Don't try the nice-guy act on live camera! Wait... okay, that actually plays well for ratings. Game on!

choices.label: Did your dentist sponsor the Double Bounty too?
choices.playerSpokenText: Careful leaning over the Spiral Core, Trevor — the glare off those veneers might blind the camera crew.
choices.rivalReplyText: Laugh it up! When you choke on this bounty tile, I'm making your wince my profile banner!

choices.label: Put Apex's money on the Core — I'm taking it twice.
choices.playerSpokenText: You brought a stunt check to a real fight. I'm cracking the 1000-point Core and leaving you in the bloopers reel again.
choices.rivalReplyText: Oh, producers, lock the zoom lens! Tonight I'm ending the fairy tale right here in London!

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Spiral Labyrinth armed, Double Bounty hot — fifty-one million viewers are eating popcorn!

scenes.title: The London Crown: Finch vs. The Upstart

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Sixty-eight million viewers, half a million dollars on the brass rail, and one Atlantic Crown! Our underdog from Oakridge stands toe-to-toe with Lord Alistair Finch!

beats.speaker: alistair_finch
beats.text: You cleared our mist, survived our press pit, and forced an Oxford fellow to uncross his ankles. Shall we settle who owns the Rotunda?

choices.label: May the sharpest mind earn the Tokyo boarding pass.
choices.playerSpokenText: London raised my game, Alistair. Win or lose, I'm grateful for the toughest duel of my life.
choices.rivalReplyText: Spoken like a true scholar. Now brace yourself — I have no intention of packing early.

choices.label: Hope you brushed up on cinema since breakfast.
choices.playerSpokenText: I packed a sharp Oxford draft and a fresh red Screw button. Care to guess which tile has your name on it?
choices.rivalReplyText: If you force a Hollywood musical on me before sixty-eight million Britons, I shall write a furious letter to the Times.

choices.label: Hand over the pocketwatch — Tokyo is waiting for me.
choices.playerSpokenText: Dry wit doesn't beat raw speed on a twelve-turn board. Tonight the Rotunda gets a new monarch.
choices.rivalReplyText: Audacious to the bitter end! Let us see how quickly that crown slips under pressure.

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Oxford Pick & Ban locked, symphony humming — for the London Crown and $500,000, let's play!

scenes.title: The Marble Floor Applauds
scenes.locationSubhead: Grand Rotunda Hall · Atlantic Crown Claimed

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: UNBELIEVABLE! Even the stiffest upper lips in London are on their feet! The Rotunda Crown and $500,000 belong to our unstoppable challenger!

beats.speaker: alistair_finch
beats.text: Well played indeed. You have thoroughly ruined my evening and earned my complete admiration. Take my pocketwatch — Tokyo runs faster than any clock in England.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Boarding pass pinned! Next stop: Shibuya Rain-Lit Sky-Dome, two hundred million viewers, and a shogi prodigy who never blinks.

scenes.title: Scones After Defeat — And a Ticket East

beats.speaker: alistair_finch
beats.text: A spirited contest! Do stay for tea; I promise the scones are far gentler than my History picks. You pushed me closer than anyone in five years.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Don't unpack your trunk yet! Your Atlantic tour rating qualified you for Tokyo's Midnight Golden Gai Wildcard — win in Shinjuku and you crash the Quarterfinals!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Every great story needs a bruise before Tokyo. Catch the midnight flight — the rain in Shibuya loves an underdog!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: One hundred sixty million eyes blazing across Tokyo! Rain drumming on the glass Sky-Dome while thirty thousand fans pack Shibuya Crossing outside!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Tonight's new board twist: Ice & Fire Column Sabotage! Entire columns freeze shut — spot a blazing Flame tile and solve it to shatter every ice lock for +200!

beats.speaker: kenji_takahashi
beats.text: Welcome to my dome. I read five turns ahead on this board and half a second faster on the buzzer. Show me if your legs survived the flight from London.

choices.label: Your Sky-Dome feels electric, Kenji. Ready to learn.
choices.playerSpokenText: I watched your national finals clips on the plane over. Fighting a shogi mind on Ice & Fire is the dream matchup.
choices.rivalReplyText: Respect! No ego, just pure tempo. Don't blink when the flame tiles light up.

choices.label: Zero-Lag? Hope the Tokyo Wi-Fi holds up.
choices.playerSpokenText: Five moves ahead is impressive, Kenji — right up until I melt the column you were banking on.
choices.rivalReplyText: Haha, counterplay trash talk already! Let's see if your recall matches your banter.

choices.label: I'm about to patch out your winning streak.
choices.playerSpokenText: Speed only counts when you're right. I'm shattering your ice locks and running the Shibuya board myself.
choices.rivalReplyText: Big talk in my home dome! Keep that energy when my Freeze hits your strongest column.

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Thermal gauges hot, jumbotrons glowing — thaw the Shibuya Dome!

scenes.title: Golden Gai Midnight Triage
scenes.locationSubhead: Golden Gai Quiz Bar · Shinjuku, Tokyo

beats.speaker: priya_nair
beats.text: Rough draw knocked both of us into Tokyo's rain-alley wildcard. Good — I perform better at 1 AM than under studio hairspray anyway.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Forty-five million insomniacs are streaming Golden Gai live! Defuse Time-Bomb Hot Potato before Priya does and you jump straight back into Shibuya's main bracket.

choices.label: No one I'd rather fight back alongside, Priya.
choices.playerSpokenText: If we have to claw our way out of Shinjuku at midnight, let's make it the cleanest duel on the stream.
choices.rivalReplyText: Steady pulse, clean focus. Winner buys steaming ramen across the alley.

choices.label: Are hot-potato bombs covered by hospital insurance?
choices.playerSpokenText: A ticking game-show fuse in a twelve-seat bar — definitely beats waiting room magazines.
choices.rivalReplyText: Just don't drop the bomb on my turn. My caffeine hasn't peaked yet.

choices.label: Sorry, Doctor — this wildcard seat is mine.
choices.playerSpokenText: I didn't fly halfway around the planet to flatline in Shinjuku. Brace for rapid-fire buzzers.
choices.rivalReplyText: High blood pressure makes people miss details. Let's test your nerve right now.

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Fuse lit, chopsticks down — defuse the Golden Gai board!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Look up! Every billboard over Shibuya Crossing is mirroring our board live — and introducing Multiplier Contagion!

beats.speaker: kenji_takahashi
beats.text: String answers together and golden 2x fever spreads into every touching tile! Build an avalanche — or watch me hijack your glowing cluster in one turn.

choices.label: A streak board built for grandmasters. Let's trade sparks.
choices.playerSpokenText: You designed a board that rewards rhythm and courage. Let's light up every screen in Tokyo.
choices.rivalReplyText: Yes! That's why two hundred million people refused to turn off their phones tonight!

choices.label: So I light the gold tiles and you try to mug me?
choices.playerSpokenText: Let me make sure I follow: I start the Gold Fever party and you crash it uninvited?
choices.rivalReplyText: Only if you hesitate for half a second! Keep the combo alive and I can't touch you.

choices.label: Apex wants a 4-streak? I'll turn the whole board gold.
choices.playerSpokenText: No hijacks, no mercy. Once my streak catches fire, you won't get a single clean tile.
choices.rivalReplyText: Bold claim! Let's see who burns out first when the 800-point tiles ignite.

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Gold Fever armed! Thirty thousand umbrellas cheering below — hit that buzzer!

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Two hours south by bullet train, paper lanterns reflect off rain-wet cedar. No microphones — only cedar wood, brass tiles, and soft rain.

beats.speaker: alistair_finch
beats.text: Delighted you answered the crimson wax envelope. Kyoto's elders wish to observe whether your London poise survives a quieter room.

beats.speaker: alistair_finch
beats.text: Velvet Diagonal Crossroads once more. Complete a full line sweep here and the Society will remember your name in Cairo.

choices.label: Peaceful rooms sharpen the mind more than roaring domes.
choices.playerSpokenText: After Shibuya's neon storm, hearing rain on cedar while playing high-stakes trivia feels sacred. Thank you for the seat.
choices.rivalReplyText: Exquisitely put. The patrons behind the screen just nodded in unison.

choices.label: Still refusing to touch a Pop Culture tile, Alistair?
choices.playerSpokenText: Notice how Velvet salons mysteriously forget to invite cinema or sports columns?
choices.rivalReplyText: An intentional mercy for everyone's blood pressure. Now kindly pick your opening square.

choices.label: I'll take the $950,000 purse and the Society's respect.
choices.playerSpokenText: Quiet table, giant stakes — suits me fine. Watch me sweep an entire row straight across your cedar board.
choices.rivalReplyText: Such magnificent impatience. Let us test whether ambition outruns precision.

closingBeats.speaker: narrator
closingBeats.text: A cedar clapper strikes twice. Twin crimson diagonals gleam beneath Kyoto lantern light.

beats.speaker: alistair_finch
beats.text: Good evening. Before you celebrate Tokyo prematurely, I took the liberty of sponsoring a small Double Bounty on your softest academic column.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Whoa! Lord Finch brought British frost straight into Shibuya! An unscheduled Oxford Pick & Ban challenge with 175 million watching live!

choices.label: If this sharpens me for Kenji, bring the bounty on.
choices.playerSpokenText: You're testing my weakest column before the Quarterfinal climax? Honestly, Alistair, that's the toughest coaching I could ask for.
choices.rivalReplyText: Hmph. Difficult to maintain a proper grudge when one's rival keeps thanking them. En garde!

choices.label: Flew twelve hours just to throw a pop quiz at me?
choices.playerSpokenText: Eleven time zones, jet lag, and monsoon rain — all to sponsor one Double Bounty? I'm flattered.
choices.rivalReplyText: Never underestimate the petty endurance of an Oxford don. Step up to the podium.

choices.label: Beat you in London, I'll beat you in Tokyo too.
choices.playerSpokenText: Double Bounty noted. I'll collect your sponsor bonus and hand you a second boarding pass home.
choices.rivalReplyText: Charmingly insufferable! Watch your comfort column — I just drafted it into oblivion.

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Bounty armed, draft knives out — rain-glass showdown in Tokyo begins NOW!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Two hundred eighty million viewers! $1,500,000 on the line, six blazing columns of Ice & Fire, and the World Quarterfinal ticket to Giza!

beats.speaker: kenji_takahashi
beats.text: Every screen in Shibuya is locked onto our two podiums. No warmups, no lag — let's give 280 million people a speedrun they clip for a decade!

choices.label: Win or lose, let's give Tokyo a masterpiece, Kenji.
choices.playerSpokenText: You raised the speed limit of this entire tournament. Let's make every single turn worth remembering.
choices.rivalReplyText: GG before Turn 1! Give me your absolute fastest read — I'm holding nothing back!

choices.label: Hope you brought mittens for your frozen columns.
choices.playerSpokenText: You freeze my comfort lane, I drop a Flame tile and melt the whole dome. Fair trade?
choices.rivalReplyText: Haha, only if your hand beats mine to the Flame! Watch the clock!

choices.label: Your home dome gets quiet in twelve turns.
choices.playerSpokenText: Two hundred eighty million people are about to watch a shogi prodigy lose tempo in his own house.
choices.rivalReplyText: Cold! Let's see how loud you talk when your favorite column locks solid on Turn 2!

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Six columns, all seven formats live — Shibuya Quarterfinal, BUZZERS HOT!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: STOP THE CLOCK! Thirty thousand fans outside Shibuya Crossing just erupted in the pouring rain! You outpaced Zero-Lag himself for $1,500,000!

beats.speaker: kenji_takahashi
beats.text: Wait — you actually out-tempoed me in my own dome?! Pure respect. Take my Cyber Link charm and go tear up Cairo!

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Act IV unlocked! Charter jet's fueled for Egypt — the Great Starlight Pavilion at Giza and World Memory Champion Nadia Al-Mansoor await!

scenes.title: Outpaced in Neon — Freight Flight to Cairo

beats.speaker: kenji_takahashi
beats.text: Checkmate under the neon! Run it back anytime — you pushed my tempo harder than anyone all season. Don't let this end your climb.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Check your Tour Trunk — Cairo's Midnight Rooftop Wildcard in Khan el-Khalili still has an open Semifinal berth! Grab your passport!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Nobody remembers who tripped in Tokyo once they conquer Giza. Board that plane and roar back!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Four hundred ninety million viewers across sixty languages! An open-air brass stage under desert stars facing four thousand years of limestone history!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: We open the World Semifinals on Pyramid Ascent: crack the wide sandstone base rows to shatter the chained summit vault at the top of the board!

beats.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
beats.text: Welcome to Giza. I have watched every tape of your climb from Oakridge to this pavilion. Reaching these steps proves you belong in the conversation.

choices.label: To stand beneath these stars with you is unforgettable, Nadia.
choices.playerSpokenText: I grew up reading about Alexandria and Giza. Playing a World Semifinal against a true polyglot here feels surreal.
choices.rivalReplyText: Keep that wonder alive. The players who survive Viktor Volkov are the ones who never forget why they loved learning.

choices.label: Hope you memorized my good episodes, not my bloopers.
choices.playerSpokenText: You watched all my tapes? Please tell me you fast-forwarded through my Channel 7 commercial breaks.
choices.rivalReplyText: I never fast-forward. A rival's stumbles reveal twice as much as their highlights.

choices.label: Study all you want — I'm not the same player from Act I.
choices.playerSpokenText: Past tapes are history, Nadia. Tonight I climb this pyramid and put the whole semifinal bracket on notice.
choices.rivalReplyText: Confidence looks sharp under desert lights. Let us see how it holds when the apex vault locks.

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Desert wind calm, sixty translators live — climb the Giza Pyramid!

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Don't look so shocked, kid! Cairo's late-night wildcard needed an underdog host-challenger and nobody pours mint tea over a ticking fuse like Brooklyn!

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: One hundred forty million viewers tuned in just to watch you fight off elimination! Beat Time-Bomb Hot Potato here and you crash straight back into Giza!

choices.label: From Oakridge folding chairs to a Cairo rooftop — still us.
choices.playerSpokenText: Forty-two locals in Brooklyn, now 140 million under Cairo lanterns. No better way to shake off Tokyo than playing you, Frankie.
choices.rivalReplyText: Gets me right in the chest every time! Now quit buttering me up and defuse this board!

choices.label: Are you opening a pub in Egypt too, Frankie?
choices.playerSpokenText: First Soho, now Khan el-Khalili — are you following the tour or scouting tavern franchises?
choices.rivalReplyText: A guy can diversify! Watch your clock before that fuse sings your eyebrows!

choices.label: No warmups — I'm blowing past this wildcard in record time.
choices.playerSpokenText: Love the mint tea, Frankie, but my head's already back at the Starlight Pavilion. Watch me clear this rooftop.
choices.rivalReplyText: Ooh, eyes on the pyramids already! Don't trip on the pub champ on your way up!

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Cairo rooftops glowing, fuses sparking — keep the Cinderella dream alive!

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Beneath Alexandria's hushed stone arches, a brass lamp illuminates twenty crystal tiles laced with crimson silk.

beats.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
beats.text: Before 780 million people judge us on television, I wished to test your mind without sponsors, buzzers, or studio noise.

beats.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
beats.text: Velvet Diagonal Crossroads — zero lifelines if you wish the Velvet Society to speak your name alongside Grandmaster Volkov's.

choices.label: Just two minds and a quiet room — the purest game there is.
choices.playerSpokenText: No cameras, no betting lines, just pure curiosity under Alexandria's vaults. I wouldn't miss this table for ten million dollars.
choices.rivalReplyText: Spoken with rare grace. You may yet belong at the High Table.

choices.label: Does the Velvet Society ever play in a room with bright lights?
choices.playerSpokenText: Oxford cloisters, Kyoto lanterns, Alexandria vaults — I'm starting to think the Society is allergic to fluorescent bulbs.
choices.rivalReplyText: Flattering candlelight hides the sweat when a 2x diagonal turns lethal. Your move.

choices.label: Keep the cameras off — I'm still sweeping your diagonals.
choices.playerSpokenText: Lifelines untouched, stakes high. I'll beat you in the shadows tonight and under Giza's spotlights tomorrow.
choices.rivalReplyText: Fierce resolve. Let us test whether ambition holds its edge in total silence.

closingBeats.speaker: narrator
closingBeats.text: A bronze chime echoes down the archive corridors. The crimson diagonals catch the lamplight.

scenes.title: High-Roller Power-Play Minefield
scenes.locationSubhead: Nile Felucca Live Floating Set · Cairo

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Five hundred twenty million watching live on the Nile! Apex Network just unleashed our wildest board yet: High-Roller Power-Play Minefield!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Four invisible Power-Play wager bombs are buried beneath ordinary tiles! Step on one and you MUST spin the brass wager dial before seeing the clue!

beats.speaker: trevor_blake
beats.text: Big money, bigger ratings, baby! Apex put Syndicate Golden Dice in the pot — let's see if your nerve holds when the Nile starts rocking!

choices.label: High-wire TV at its best, Trevor. Let's give them a show.
choices.playerSpokenText: You know how to build a spectacle, I'll give you that. May the boldest wager win the Nile.
choices.rivalReplyText: Now you're talking network language! Let's blow the roof off the overnight ratings!

choices.label: Four hidden mines and a floating boat — what could go wrong?
choices.playerSpokenText: Apex strapped a $1.75M wager board to a wooden riverboat and handed Trevor a microphone. Truly peak journalism.
choices.rivalReplyText: Hey, half a billion viewers don't tune in for safety rails! Spin the dial when you hit a mine!

choices.label: I'm going all-in on the first mine I trigger.
choices.playerSpokenText: Keep your life jacket buckled, Trevor. I'm taking Apex's dice, the bonus purse, and your prime-time slot.
choices.rivalReplyText: Whoa! Producers, get a camera on that poker face — we're about to watch someone sink or swim!

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Four hidden mines armed, lanterns reflecting on the Nile — step carefully!

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A tall shadow detaches from the brass telescope dome. No camera flash. No announcer. Defending 3-Time World Champion Grandmaster Viktor Volkov.

beats.speaker: viktor_volkov
beats.text: Three championships, forty-two challengers, and never once did an open-call newcomer earn a seat in the Citadel Crypt. Until tonight.

beats.speaker: viktor_volkov
beats.text: Let us play one quiet Spiral Labyrinth before the world watches. Peel inward to the 1000-point Core — I wish to see how you think when no crowd cheers.

choices.label: Testing myself against the greatest alive is why I entered.
choices.playerSpokenText: I studied your past finals from Oakridge to London, Grandmaster. Sitting across this Spiral board is an honor.
choices.rivalReplyText: Good. Reverence without fear is the rarest trait in a challenger. Show me your opening move.

choices.label: Scouting me off-camera? Starting to worry about Act V?
choices.playerSpokenText: An undefeated World Champion sneaking into a Cairo observatory just to measure an underdog? I'll take that as a compliment.
choices.rivalReplyText: A careful architect inspects every storm before it reaches the roof. Begin.

choices.label: Remember tonight — it's the first time your throne shakes.
choices.playerSpokenText: No applause needed. I'll crack your Spiral Core here in the dark, and I'll take your crown in the light.
choices.rivalReplyText: Bold words echo loudly inside stone domes. Let us see whether your mind echoes back.

closingBeats.speaker: narrator
closingBeats.text: Viktor rests two fingertips beside his buzzer, motionless as marble. The Spiral Labyrinth unlocks its outer ring.

scenes.title: Grudge Ambush: The Speedrun Minefield
scenes.locationSubhead: Giza Backstage Press Veranda · Live Feed

beats.speaker: kenji_takahashi
beats.text: Thought you left me behind in Shibuya? I pulled your Career Stats radar, funded a Cairo Minefield bounty, and locked directly onto your weakest domain!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Unscheduled Giza showdown! Beat Kenji's ambush across four hidden wager mines and you walk away with the coveted Screw Shield charm!

choices.label: You push me harder every city we meet, Kenji. Bring it.
choices.playerSpokenText: If I can survive a Kenji Takahashi ambush in a Power-Play Minefield, nothing Viktor throws at me will rattle my nerves.
choices.rivalReplyText: Haha, okay — hard to stay mad at someone who treats my ambush like free training! Lock in!

choices.label: Careful — my Screw Shield is about to bounce your trap back.
choices.playerSpokenText: You crossed a continent to drop a bounty on my weak spot, and forgot I still know Culinary Arts better than you?
choices.rivalReplyText: Whoa — low blow on the pastry questions! Hit the buzzer and settle it!

choices.label: Two cities, two losses — step behind the podium.
choices.playerSpokenText: Shibuya wasn't a fluke and neither is Cairo. I'm taking your bounty and that Screw Shield.
choices.rivalReplyText: No mercy, zero lag! Let's see your win rate survive Turn 3!

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Four mines buried, Screw tokens live — Giza Press Veranda, GO!

scenes.title: Master Velvet Salon: The Seal of Seven

beats.speaker: alistair_finch
beats.text: Seven wax seals have never been broken by an open-call contestant. Defeat me across six columns of Velvet Diagonal Crossroads without lifelines, and the Society backs your Finals run.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Behind velvet curtains, seven hooded patrons lower brass lamps toward the twin glowing X tracks.

choices.label: I accept the Seal of Seven on pure scholarship.
choices.playerSpokenText: No lifelines, six columns, crimson diagonals. Let's honor the finest minds who ever sat at this table, Alistair.
choices.rivalReplyText: Magnificent poise. Whatever happens under the Finals dome, you are already one of us.

choices.label: Do I get a cool hooded cloak if I sweep the X?
choices.playerSpokenText: Win without lifelines and I get $2.6M plus Velvet backing — tell me a tailored velvet cape comes with the Seal.
choices.rivalReplyText: Strictly linen waistcoats in Cairo heat, I'm afraid. Now earn the crest!

choices.label: Break out the crimson wax — I'm taking the High Table.
choices.playerSpokenText: Keep your lifelines sealed in velvet. I'll clear both diagonals and rewrite the Society's record book tonight.
choices.rivalReplyText: My word, you'd challenge Caesar for his laurel wreath. Begin!

closingBeats.speaker: narrator
closingBeats.text: Seven brass bells chime in descending harmony. The six-column Velvet Crossroads blazes to life.

beats.speaker: priya_nair
beats.text: Before you step up against Nadia Al-Mansoor, we have unfinished surgical business. I'm prescribing six columns of Fog of War straight into your weak spots.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Five hundred sixty million viewers! Dr. Priya Nair is putting your semifinals vitals to the ultimate Fog test right before Giza's climax!

choices.label: No better diagnostic before Nadia than facing you, Priya.
choices.playerSpokenText: You're the sharpest surgeon on this tour. If I clear your Fog board cleanly, I know I'm ready for Giza's climax.
choices.rivalReplyText: Good vitals, zero ego. Let's run a clean twelve-turn procedure.

choices.label: Doctor, is desert fog covered under my tour physical?
choices.playerSpokenText: Wait — you're charging me a $2.1M copay just to check my weak domains in Giza?
choices.rivalReplyText: Out-of-network specialist rates. Keep your eyes on the illuminated squares.

choices.label: Check your own pulse — I'm clearing this fog fast.
choices.playerSpokenText: Save the clinical warnings for someone who panics. I'm illuminating every Crown Wedge before Turn 10.
choices.rivalReplyText: Overconfidence spikes adrenaline and ruins recall. Let's test your hypothesis.

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Desert mist rolling across six columns — light up the Giza amphitheater!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: SEVEN HUNDRED EIGHTY MILLION WATCHING LIVE! $3,500,000 on the line, ancient stone glowing gold, and the first full 6-Column Championship Gauntlet against Nadia Al-Mansoor!

beats.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
beats.text: Half the waking planet is watching tonight. Let us honor them by playing without hesitation — whoever wins this pavilion faces Grandmaster Viktor Volkov.

choices.label: Let's give 780 million people a semifinal for the ages, Nadia.
choices.playerSpokenText: Every language on that broadcast deserves our absolute best. Thank you for meeting me beneath the Pyramids.
choices.rivalReplyText: Magnificent. Step up to the six columns — let history decide who walks into the Finale.

choices.label: Just promise not to memorize my poker face mid-wager.
choices.playerSpokenText: Six columns, all seven formats, and a World Memory Champion reading my blinks. Good thing I brought a Screw buzzer.
choices.rivalReplyText: Save your red dome for my blind spot — if you can find it before I claim all six Wedges.

choices.label: Viktor is waiting for me — not you.
choices.playerSpokenText: I didn't fight through London and Shibuya to stop one step short of ten million dollars. This pavilion is mine.
choices.rivalReplyText: Then prove your fire outlasts stone and starlight. Touch your buzzer.

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Six columns blazing under the Pyramids, orchestra roaring — WORLD SEMIFINAL LIVE!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: YOU DID IT! Seven hundred eighty million viewers jumping off couches across every continent! $3,500,000 banked — YOU ARE GOING TO THE WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP FINALE!

beats.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
beats.text: You earned every cheer tonight. Take my Astrolabe onto the Grand Finale stage — and don't let Viktor Volkov make the room feel cold. Make it yours.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Act V unlocked! Global Championship Arena, 1.4 billion live simulcast viewers, ten million dollars, and Grandmaster Viktor Volkov waiting on the brass podium!

scenes.title: Heartbreak Under Desert Stars — One Last Door

beats.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
beats.text: What a semifinal! Hold your head high — nobody alive came this close to knocking me off pace beneath the Pyramids.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Listen to me! One wildcard seat remains for Finals Week via Geneva's Last-Chance Basement Repêchage — win there and you STILL collide with Viktor Volkov!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: The greatest Cinderella runs always go through the back door. Pack your charms and get on that plane to Geneva!

scenes.title: Curtain Up: One Billion Tuned In
scenes.locationSubhead: Global Championship Arena · Finals Week Opening

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Look around this coliseum! Forty-two folding chairs in Oakridge brought us here — a ninety-piece symphony pit and nearly ONE BILLION viewers tuning in for Finals Week!

beats.speaker: viktor_volkov
beats.text: You survived London, Tokyo, and Cairo. Impressive. Clear the final contender bracket, and we shall see if your fairy tale survives fourteen championship turns.

choices.label: Save my seat beside yours, Grandmaster. I'm coming.
choices.playerSpokenText: Every city taught me something I needed for this room. Keep the brass crown polished until Friday night.
choices.rivalReplyText: A composed answer. Win your opening seed cleanly and earn our confrontation.

choices.label: Forty-two folding chairs had better coffee than this arena.
choices.playerSpokenText: Ninety symphony musicians, marble chandeliers, and I still miss Frankie's busted coffee urn. Ready to roll!
choices.rivalReplyText: Humor in the shadow of a billion cameras. Unusual — and mildly dangerous.

choices.label: Three championships end this week, Viktor.
choices.playerSpokenText: You've defended perfection against forty-two challengers. Number forty-three didn't fly here for second place.
choices.rivalReplyText: Forty-two challengers spoke identical sentences. Let the scoreboard render the verdict.

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Finals Week Opening Night — Gold Fever Contagion across six gleaming columns, GO!

scenes.title: The Cinderella Play-In: No Safety Net

beats.speaker: alistair_finch
beats.text: Fancy meeting you in a concrete Swiss basement. The bookmakers gave both of us five-hundred-to-one odds — which rather makes me want to ruin their weekend.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Six hundred forty million people tuned into the Cinderella Play-In! Thaw Ice & Fire Column Sabotage in Geneva and walk straight into the Global Arena!

choices.label: Win or lose, let's ruin the bookmakers' weekend together.
choices.playerSpokenText: From Oxford marble to concrete walls — there's nobody sharper I'd rather duel for a second life, Alistair.
choices.rivalReplyText: Hear, hear! Raise the buzzers and melt this absurdly cold room.

choices.label: No velvet drapes down here — still okay to play?
choices.playerSpokenText: Fluorescent tubes, folding table, and zero tea service. Sure you can concentrate, Lord Finch?
choices.rivalReplyText: I survived English boarding school; a Swiss basement is practically the Ritz. Play on!

choices.label: Only one underdog walks upstairs to Viktor — it's me.
choices.playerSpokenText: Appreciate the dry humor, Alistair, but I'm shattering every frozen column and taking that Finals pass right now.
choices.rivalReplyText: Merciless to the very last chime! Very well — show me your fire!

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Basement cameras rolling, 640M cheering for a miracle — PLAY!

scenes.title: The Velvet Sovereign Vault
scenes.locationSubhead: Beneath Geneva's Clocktowers · Final Velvet Salon

beats.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
beats.text: One chair at the Velvet High Table has waited vacant for a decade. Conquer six columns of Velvet Diagonal Crossroads without a lifeline, and you enter tomorrow's Finale wearing our supreme crest.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Candlelight ripples across engraved mahogany. Even the clocktower bells above pause for the opening tile.

choices.label: Let mastery speak louder than any broadcast tower.
choices.playerSpokenText: No lifelines, no crowd noise, just pure intellect across six columns. Ready when you are, Nadia.
choices.rivalReplyText: Serene and fearless. The High Table is watching every beat of this duel.

choices.label: Winner skips the traffic straight to Viktor's podium?
choices.playerSpokenText: A $3.6M purse, the Society's crest, and a direct velvet carpet to the World Finale? Best shortcut on the tour.
choices.rivalReplyText: Only a shortcut if you survive thirteen turns without touching a single coin. Begin.

choices.label: Leave the vacant chair warm — it's mine tonight.
choices.playerSpokenText: I'll clear your crimson X untouched, take the Velvet Sovereign title, and dethrone Viktor tomorrow.
choices.rivalReplyText: Unflinching ambition. Prove you can carry the silence before the storm.

closingBeats.speaker: narrator
closingBeats.text: One pure silver chord rings out. The Velvet Sovereign Crossroads illuminates in crimson and gold.

beats.speaker: viktor_volkov
beats.text: Rivals you bruised along the tour pooled a curious bounty for tonight's eve broadcast. They believe fog and pressure will fracture your composure before tomorrow.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Championship Eve psychological warfare! Over ONE BILLION people watching Viktor Volkov test your nerve in 6-column Fog of War — win here to forge the Screw Shield!

choices.label: Good — I'd rather face your storm awake than asleep.
choices.playerSpokenText: If you want to measure my steel twelve hours before the Finale, Viktor, turn up the lights and bring the fog.
choices.rivalReplyText: Rare nerve. Tomorrow will be the finest championship of my career.

choices.label: Funny — champions usually sleep before a $10M match.
choices.playerSpokenText: Three-time champion pacing the sparring floor at midnight? Sounds like I'm living rent-free inside your head.
choices.rivalReplyText: Insomnia is the price of vigilance. Let us see how quickly your smile fades inside the fog.

choices.label: Keep the bounties coming — I'll beat you tonight AND tomorrow.
choices.playerSpokenText: Every grudge on this tour only made me faster. I'm taking that Screw Shield right off your podium.
choices.rivalReplyText: Then let us burn away every illusion before sunrise. Ready your hand.

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: Arena floodlights halved, fog rolling across six columns — Championship Eve duel, LIVE!

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Look at the live ticker — Oakridge, Soho, Shibuya, and Cairo all lit up #1 worldwide! Nearly nine hundred million viewers are watching your Last-Stand Tiebreaker!

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Every single folding chair in Oakridge Hall is packed wall to wall, kid! Crack that six-column Spiral Core and kick the Championship Finale doors right off the hinges!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: You took every punch this global tour could throw and NEVER stayed down! One Spiral Labyrinth stands between you and 1.4 billion viewers — GO TAKE IT!

choices.label: For every underdog who ever refused to quit.
choices.playerSpokenText: Forty-two folding chairs got me started and every comeback made me unbreakable. Let's crack this Core.
choices.rivalReplyText: Bring the roof down, kid! Oakridge is screaming so loud the bar glasses are rattling!

choices.label: Hope Viktor didn't cancel his dinner plans for tomorrow.
choices.playerSpokenText: Tell Grandmaster Volkov to keep the extra podium plugged in — I'm not done ruining betting odds yet.
choices.rivalReplyText: Ha! Five-hundred-to-one and still talking smack! Go light up that Spiral!

choices.label: Nothing on Earth is keeping me off that Finale stage.
choices.playerSpokenText: Thirteen turns, 1000-point Core, zero hesitation. Open the board and watch a miracle happen live.
choices.rivalReplyText: Pure lightning! Tear that Spiral straight down to the brass!

closingBeats.speaker: max_sterling
closingBeats.text: The Cinderella Last-Stand Tiebreaker — peel the Spiral and march onto the World Finale!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN ACROSS PLANET EARTH! ONE POINT FOUR BILLION LIVE VIEWERS! TEN MILLION DOLLARS! Every continent tuned in for THE WORLD'S SMARTEST FINALE!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Behold The 6-Column Championship Gauntlet: all six Jewel Wedges, chained 800-point vaults, hidden Power Plays, live Screw buzzers, and every single format we built across fourteen unforgettable turns!

beats.speaker: viktor_volkov
beats.text: From forty-two folding chairs in Oakridge to the loudest silence on Earth. Show me everything every rival, every city, and every setback taught you tonight.

choices.label: Every rival I met stands behind this podium. Let's make history.
choices.playerSpokenText: You're the standard every trivia player on Earth measures themselves against, Viktor. Let's give 1.4 billion people a final they tell their grandkids about.
choices.rivalReplyText: Well spoken. For the first time in three years, I feel genuine anticipation. Begin.
choices.hostReplyText: Symphony full fortissimo! Hands on buzzers — FOR THE WORLD CROWN!

choices.label: Hope you brushed up on pop songs and street food, Grandmaster.
choices.playerSpokenText: History, Science, Logic — you're a monument, Viktor. Just pray my red Screw buzzer doesn't land on Culinary Arts.
choices.rivalReplyText: Ah — Nadia has been whispering into your telephone. Very well. Let us test your aim.
choices.hostReplyText: OH! Shots fired before Turn 1! 1.4 billion people just leaned forward!

choices.label: Fourteen turns. Ten million dollars. New World Champion.
choices.playerSpokenText: Your reign ends under these lights tonight, Grandmaster. I'm taking every Wedge, every vault, and the brass crown.
choices.rivalReplyText: Then step into the crucible and pry it from my hands. Show the planet what you are.
choices.hostReplyText: CHILLS DOWN MY SPINE! Six columns blazing — PLAY FOR TEN MILLION DOLLARS!

closingBeats.speaker: narrator
closingBeats.text: The symphony strikes its thunderous opening chord. Six crystal-and-brass columns ignite beneath 1.4 billion watching eyes.

scenes.title: The Crown Changes Hands!
scenes.locationSubhead: Global Championship Arena · History Made Live

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: THE BUZZER SOUNDS! GOLDEN CONFETTI FALLING FROM THE RAFTERS! ONE POINT FOUR BILLION PEOPLE JUST WITNESSED THE GREATEST CORONATION IN BROADCAST HISTORY!

beats.speaker: viktor_volkov
beats.text: Fourteen hundred million witnesses, and not a single wasted turn. For the first time in three years, I step down with a smile. The World Crown is yours.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Every satellite feed on Earth is lighting up at once — step into center spotlight and claim your legend!

scenes.title: By a Razor's Edge — And the World Roars Encore!

beats.speaker: viktor_volkov
beats.text: By the narrowest margin of my entire life. You forced me to play every turn at my absolute limit. Do not vanish from this stage — the whole world wants an encore.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Look at the broadcast wall! Three hundred million viewers just flooded the petition desk demanding an immediate Encore — win the Midnight Last-Stand Tiebreaker and you march straight back out against Viktor!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: You didn't lose the crowd — you made the whole planet fall in love with your fight! Take a deep breath, hit the Encore Tiebreaker, and take that crown on the rematch!

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: No corporate leash, no secret handshake, zero strings attached! From forty-two folding chairs in Oakridge to $10,000,000 and 1.4 billion cheering hearts — THE PEOPLE'S CHAMPION!

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The arena jumbotron splits live to Oakridge Community Hall, packed with four hundred shouting neighbors. Frankie Russo raises a frosty ginger ale toward the lens while Denise Park wipes her glasses and pretends it is dust.

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: You never forgot who bought the first round, kid! You turned down the big-suit networks and proved curiosity belongs to regular folks everywhere!

beats.speaker: priya_nair
beats.text: Every ER break room in Boston stopped breathing on Turn 14. Best vital sign I've seen all year.

beats.speaker: viktor_volkov
beats.text: I walked onstage alone for three years. Tonight I watched an entire world walk onstage with you. Wear the crown proudly.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Ten million dollars, one battered Tour Trunk, and a hometown barstool forever reserved in solid brass. Good night, Planet Earth — you just met the World's Smartest!

scenes.title: Ending II: The Network Sovereign
scenes.locationSubhead: Apex Network Syndicate Victory · Prime-Time Dynasty

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: STOP THE PRESSES AND RE-PRICE THE COMMERCIAL SLOTS! Every Showman Dare cashed, every Power Play doubled, $10,000,000 plus Apex escalators — BOW TO THE NETWORK SOVEREIGN!

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Flashbulbs strobe like summer lightning as Apex Network executives sprint onto the brass floor bearing a velvet-lined prime-time showrunner contract — and a check too wide for one camera lens.

beats.speaker: trevor_blake
beats.text: Okay, I officially surrender the Broadcast White crown! Please tell me your new primetime show needs a slightly humbled sidekick with phenomenal hair!

beats.speaker: kenji_takahashi
beats.text: Every wager you made broke Tokyo's live clip servers twice! Pure high-roller ice — respect!

beats.speaker: viktor_volkov
beats.text: Showmanship rarely survives true scholarship. Tonight you weaponized spectacle and beat me with it. An astonishing dynasty begins.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Somebody call my agent before this champion takes my tuxedo and my desk! You conquered the board AND the broadcast — long live the Network Sovereign!

scenes.title: Ending III: The Velvet Grandmaster
scenes.locationSubhead: The Velvet Society Victory · Chair at the High Table

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: One point four billion applauded under the arena lights — yet after the cameras fade to black, a quieter legend steps through the velvet curtains.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The coliseum doors swing shut. Under dimmed brass chandeliers, a crimson wax envelope slides across the podium — broken not by producers, but by four quiet masters.

beats.speaker: alistair_finch
beats.text: Oxford, Kyoto, Alexandria, Geneva — you conquered every forbidden Crossroads without blinking. Allow me to pour the first cup for our newest Sovereign.

beats.speaker: denise_park
beats.text: An unbroken A-plus thesis written across five continents. I retire my red fountain pen knowing the table is in extraordinary hands.

beats.speaker: nadia_al_mansoor
beats.text: Ten million dollars buys comfort; mastering the hardest rooms on Earth without lifelines buys immortality. Welcome to the Velvet High Table, Grandmaster.

beats.speaker: viktor_volkov
beats.text: At last, an equal who plays for the beauty of the board itself. Take the center chair — I look forward to our midnight rematches.

scenes.title: Ending IV: The Cinderella Redemption Crown

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: THEY WROTE YOU OFF! FIVE HUNDRED TO ONE! You fought through smoky Soho basements, neon Tokyo alleys, Cairo rooftops, and Swiss tiebreakers — AND YOU JUST STOLE THE WORLD CROWN!

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The brass Tour Trunk beside your podium is covered in torn pub flyers, rain-stained boarding passes, and red yarn lines tracing every defeat you refused to accept as an ending.

beats.speaker: producer_sam
beats.text: Tears in the control booth! Every wildcard cellar and midnight train on five continents just turned into the greatest sports story ever broadcast!

beats.speaker: frankie_russo
beats.text: Nobody ever won this crown taking the hard road through the mud — until you! Every bruised underdog on Planet Earth is walking six inches taller tomorrow!

beats.speaker: viktor_volkov
beats.text: I spent twenty years studying perfection. I thought an unbeaten record made me invincible. Tonight, in front of 1.4 billion witnesses, you proved resilience beats perfection.

beats.speaker: max_sterling
beats.text: Symphony blaring, confetti storming, every past rival standing on their chairs — raise that $10,000,000 Cinderella Crown! You didn't just win; you refused to lose!
